run_lit_tests: run lit to execute LLVM integrated tests on a given test directory
run_lit_with_config: run lit with a custom configuration file to control test execution behavior
run_lit_incremental: run lit in incremental mode to skip tests that passed in the previous run
run_lit_with_xunit_output: run lit and generate an xunit XML output file for CI integration
run_lit_with_json_output: run lit and write test results to a JSON file for programmatic analysis
